subject: Microtrack rolling interview sprint — compressed full-loop scheduling
messages:
From: Andre Malik <andre@talentbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate intro — Taylor Nguyen (SWE) / timeline constraints

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Quick intro — Taylor Nguyen is a strong SWE candidate for the infra team. They are available for a compressed live loop on Thursday 5/28 only between 10:00–15:00 PT due to travel. Client prefers a single continuous session rather than spread over multiple days.

Resume attached. Can your team run a rolling microtrack (3 panels back-to-back with short debriefs) inside that window? Taylor’s timezone is PT.

Basic asks:
- Three interviewer panels (design, system debugging, culture/leadership)
- Each panel ~40–45 min, 10–15 min buffer between panels for context switch and notes
- One 20–30 min hiring manager close at end if feasible

If you can confirm owners for each block I’ll lock candidate availability and send invites.

Thanks,
Andre Malik
TalentBridge

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Andre Malik <andre@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate intro — Taylor Nguyen (SWE) / timeline constraints

Thanks Andre — attaching the resume and our scorecard template for visibility.

Team: we can do a compressed "microtrack" sprint on Thu 5/28 between 10:00–14:00 PT. Proposed structure (keeps candidate contiguous, short buffers):

- Block A (10:00–10:45) — System design deep-dive (owner: Jonas)
- Buffer / quick notes (10:45–10:55)
- Block B (10:55–11:40) — Live debugging / coding exercise (owner: Marissa)
- Buffer / handoff (11:40–11:50)
- Block C (11:50–12:35) — Culture / cross-team collaboration + behavioral (owner: Laura)
- Lunch / candidate break (12:35–13:05) — short pause requested by candidate
- HM close (13:05–13:30) — hiring manager final conversation (owner: Irene)

Total on-call window ends ~13:30; leaves a slim buffer for post-loop debriefs. I propose we hold a 15-minute synchronous debrief immediately after (13:30–13:45) with the panelists and separate capture in scorecard.xlsx. If panelists prefer async scoring, we can extend scoring deadline to EOD but prefer a live micro-debrief to align quickly.

Can each owner confirm availability and whether they want a 15-min live debrief or will do async? Also flag if you need a longer coding slot — I can shift timing but need to keep candidate contiguous.

Attachments: Taylor_Nguyen_Resume.pdf, scorecard-template.xlsx

— Irene Choi
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate intro — Microtrack plan confirmation

On Mon, May 18, 2026 at 10:03 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team: we can do a compressed "microtrack" sprint on Thu 5/28 between 10:00–14:00 PT. Proposed structure...

All good from me — I can own Block C (culture / collaboration) and will take notes in the scorecard. I prefer a 15-min live debrief immediately after the HM close (13:30–13:45) to align on hire/no-hire and any calibration notes.

A couple quick asks:
- Jonas, can you add one small follow-up systems prompt that ties to our infra reliability rubric? Good to give candidate a concrete anchor for how we score design tradeoffs.
- Marissa, if you need an extra 10 min on the coding exercise I can flip my buffer window to allow 11:50–12:00 overlap (still keep overall end by 13:30).

Confirming I’ll be on camera and will use the scorecard-template.xlsx to capture rubric items live.

Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
